name: App Icon: 2D Demon Kabuto Mask
purpose: Primary 2D App Store Icon — Warlord Kabuto Identity.
description: Symmetrical pure flat solid black samurai battle helmet (Kabuto) with curved crescent horns and demon Mempo faceplate, glowing crimson eye slits centered in a radiant crimson disc.
prompt: Masterwork minimalist 2D flat vector game app icon. Symmetrical pure solid black silhouette of a Japanese samurai kabuto helmet with curved golden-crimson crescent horns and a demon mempo face mask with sharp crimson eye slits. (Directly centered in front of a giant perfectly smooth solid crimson-red circular sun:1.4). Pure flat 2D graphic design, solid pitch-black (#07080C), vibrant crimson red (#D20A2E), razor-sharp clean hard vector edges, SVG vector aesthetic, no 3D rendering, no volume, no gradients, no soft shadows, no text, no pixelation, no noise.
